verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships Boxes, which the vendor says removes the guesswork from VMs: you pick the OS to install and the app handles the rest. That directly matches creating and running VMs without manual configuration. The support rests on a single marketing claim with no detail. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Boxes' automated setup (e.g. unattended install, resource defaults), and independent or hands-on corroboration that VM creation works smoothly.
